finalText:
**Build passes now**, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- `[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to use `retryCount`.
- `[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made `undefined` resolve to disabled.

The rest of the noise, `DEP0142`/`DEP0198`/etc, punycode, circular-import, unused-export, is just deprecation chatter from the bump, not build-breaking. Build finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
